earlier_attempt_policy: Retained for audit, never used to certify the final source. An earlier exit-zero attempt does not certify subsequent edits.

harness_issues.issue: Initial helper saved raw stdout/stderr and receipt before terminal printing raised UnicodeEncodeError under cp1252. Later helper uses UTF-8.

source_freezing: Final helper compiles a frozen snapshot and saves its own runner source; source hash is the snapshot hash.
transient_build: build/ contains disposable compiler import products; accepted compiled bytes are copied to verification/*_final/compiled.olean.bin and sealed there.
